title: PS5 Black Friday deals 2026 UK: the best console prices now
seoTitle: PS5 Black Friday Deals 2026 UK: Stock, PS5 Pro & Controllers
description: PS5 Black Friday 2026: where PS5 and PS5 Pro stock is at the normal price, PS Portal prices and what to avoid while GTA VI demand is high.
intro:
**Short answer: there's still no real PS5 console discount this Black Friday, because stock has run out at most UK shops since GTA VI launched on 19 November.** The best console buys right now are the **PS5 Pro at its normal £789.99 at Argos**, which still had stock on 23 and 24 November, and Very's **PS5 Digital + GTA VI + DualSense Edge bundle at £699**. Don't pay resellers: on Amazon the new PS5 Pro is only sold by marketplace sellers from about £1,299.

Currys and John Lewis are out of stock of the standard consoles, and Argos and Amazon mostly have them only in two-controller bundles. Controllers are the real deal: a DualSense is **£42.99 at Amazon** (Nova Pink and Cosmic Red) and the DualSense Edge is down to **£149 at Amazon**. The PlayStation Portal is £219 at Currys, AO and Very. Black Friday is this Friday, 27 November, and Amazon's Black Friday Week runs to 30 November. A £70 PlayStation Store code is £60.85 at ShopTo, and the SteelSeries Arctis Nova 7 Gen 2 headset is £108 at Amazon. Prices last checked on Wednesday 25 November 2026 at 6pm. For other gaming and tech deals, see our [Black Friday 2026 live deals page](/guides/black-friday-2026-live-deals-uk/).

deals.name: Sony PlayStation 5 Pro (2TB, digital)
deals.note: Full price, but Argos was one of the few big shops with stock on 23–24 November (OwlyFinds stock tracker; it depends on your postcode). Amazon itself isn't selling a new PS5 Pro: marketplace sellers want £1,299 or more, so we've turned off the Amazon comparison for this one.

deals.name: PS5 Digital Edition + GTA VI + DualSense Edge bundle
deals.note: £699 at Very, £78 under its listed £777 (T3's UK deals page, updated 25 November). Not a big discount, but it's a new console at a fair price while most shops are sold out. Check the delivery date before you pay: What Hi-Fi saw some Very bundles not arriving until 21 December. Note that Very says this bundle won't ship until 21 December (GamesRadar, 25 November), so it may not arrive before Christmas week; check the date at checkout.

deals.name: Sony DualSense Wireless Controller (Nova Pink)
deals.note: £42.99 at Amazon on the evening of 24 November (TechRadar), £22 off, and TechRadar thinks it's unlikely to go lower. Midnight Black and other colours are cut too.

deals.name: Sony DualSense Wireless Controller (Cosmic Red)
deals.note: £42.99 sold by Amazon on PriceSpy on 24 November, about £17 off. Currys has 8 of its 11 colours at £43 (GamesRadar, 24 November), so pick whichever colour you want; Amazon is the cheapest for this one.

deals.name: Sony DualSense Edge Wireless Controller (Midnight Black)
deals.note: £149 at Amazon UK on the evening of 25 November (GamesRadar's PS5 live blog, 17:17), a little under the £149.99 it's been all week; other shops want £169.99 to £199.99. Worth it for back paddles and swappable sticks if you play competitively.

deals.name: Sony DualSense Wireless Controller (Icon Blue or Wolverine Limited Edition)
deals.note: Currys has the premium limited-edition pads at £56, about £19 off (GamesRadar, 24 November). The 007 First Light pad is also £56 there against £87.99 at Amazon.

deals.name: SteelSeries Arctis Nova 7 Gen 2 Wireless Headset (Magenta)
deals.note: £108 at Amazon in Magenta, with the black version about £129 (GamesRadar, 25 November). A comfortable wireless headset that works with PS5, PC and phone at the same time.

deals.name: Star Wars Zero Company (PS5)
deals.note: £34.99 at Amazon UK (GamesRadar, 25 November). A turn-based Star Wars tactics game; Hell is Us is also down to £15 at Amazon.

deals.name: PlayStation Store £70 credit (digital code)
deals.note: £60.85 at ShopTo (TechRadar UK and GamesRadar, 25 November), so about 13% off anything on the PlayStation Store, including PS Plus. ShopTo also has the GTA VI disc at £61.85.

deals.note: Also £219 at AO and Very, and £219.99 at Argos (PriceSpy, 24 November). It was as low as about £170 in the last three months, so it's not a deal yet. You need a PS5 and good home wi-fi to use it.

body:
## PS5 prices to aim for this Black Friday

PS5 prices went up in April 2026: the Digital Edition from £429.99 to £519.99, the disc model from £479.99 to £569.99 and the PS5 Pro from £699.99 to £789.99. That makes last year's deals a less direct guide, but they show how far Sony is willing to go.

- **Black Friday 2025:** Sony's own promotion cut the Digital Edition to £294.99, the disc model to £389.99 and the PS5 Pro to £609.99, and most big retailers matched it. Argos went further on the Pro, selling it for £569.99.
- **Lowest prices in the last six months (Which?):** about £375 for the Digital Edition, £442 for the disc model and £570 for the Pro.
- **Our targets for 2026:** under £400 for the Digital Edition, under £450 for the disc model and under £650 for the PS5 Pro. Any of those is a good deal at the new prices.

## Which PS5 should you buy?

**PS5 Digital Edition:** the cheapest way in. Games are bought as downloads from the PlayStation Store, which means no second-hand games. You can add Sony's disc drive later if you change your mind, but it costs extra.

**PS5 with disc drive:** worth the extra if you buy games on disc, trade them in or borrow them, or want to play 4K Blu-rays. Over a few years, cheaper second-hand games can cover the price difference.

**PS5 Pro:** sharper picture and smoother frame rates on a good 4K TV. It doesn't come with a disc drive. Only worth the big premium if you play a lot and have a TV that shows the difference.

**Certified Refurbished:** sold by Sony with a warranty, and £90 to £120 less than new. A sensible choice if you need a console before Black Friday.

## Will the PS5 be cheaper on Black Friday 2026?

Update, 25 November: probably not this year. Grand Theft Auto VI came out on 19 November and sold in huge numbers, and many people bought a PS5 to play it. Since then the standard consoles have sold out at Currys and John Lewis, and the GTA VI bundles we listed last week from EE, Very and O2 are no longer things we can confirm at those prices, so we've taken them off. Resellers have pushed prices up sharply: What Hi-Fi saw the PS5 Digital at up to £899 and the PS5 Pro at £1,475 from third-party sellers.

What to do: buy only from a big retailer at or near Sony's prices (£519.99 Digital, £569.99 disc, £789.99 Pro), set stock alerts at Argos and Amazon, and accept a bundle with a second controller if that's all that's in stock. Sony may still run its own Black Friday promotion on games, PS Plus and accessories, which doesn't depend on console stock. Very's PS5 Digital + GTA VI + DualSense Edge bundle at £699 is the most sensible console offer we've found from a big retailer (T3, 25 November). Controllers are the one genuine PS5 deal this week: a standard DualSense is £42.99 at Amazon (Nova Pink and Cosmic Red) and £43 at Currys in most colours, and the DualSense Edge is £149.99 at Amazon (prices checked 24–25 November). [Check Amazon's DualSense prices](https://www.amazon.co.uk/s?k=DualSense+wireless+controller).

### Why is the PS5 out of stock in the UK?

Demand jumped when GTA VI launched on 19 November, just before Black Friday. Currys and John Lewis have sold out of the standard consoles, and Argos and Amazon have mostly bundles left.

### Is it worth buying a PS5 now or waiting for Black Friday?

If you find a PS5 in stock at a big retailer at Sony's normal price, buy it: with stock this short, waiting for a discount is more likely to leave you without one. Never pay a reseller hundreds over the normal price; stock usually recovers after the Christmas rush.

### When do PS5 Black Friday deals start?

Bundle deals started in mid-November, but most sold out after GTA VI's launch on 19 November. Last year Sony's promotion ran from 21 November to Cyber Monday; this year, with consoles scarce, expect any savings to be on games, PS Plus and accessories rather than the consoles.

### Should I buy a PS5 Digital Edition or the disc version?

Digital if you're happy buying all your games online. Disc if you like second-hand games or lending games to friends, as the savings on games add up.

### Is a refurbished PS5 worth it?

Sony's Certified Refurbished consoles are checked and come with a warranty, so they're a safe buy. The Digital Edition was £429.99 when we checked on 22 October; we couldn't confirm today's price, and it may have gone up. With new consoles scarce this year, refurbished is worth a look.

See also our [Black Friday 2026 guides](/black-friday/), including [Nintendo Switch 2](/guides/nintendo-switch-2-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Lego](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/), and [what to buy now and what to wait for](/spotlight/black-friday-2026-buy-now-or-wait/).
